newsitem.title: USA: Black & Decker reports higher profits.
newsitem.headline: Black & Decker reports higher profits.

text.p: Black & Decker Corp. Tuesday reported a 28 percent jump in earnings for the latest quarter, led by strong U.S. sales of professional power tools, security hardware and plumbing products.
The company said it earned $55.8 million or 58 cents a share in the third quarter, up from earnings of $43.5 million or 46 cents a share a year ago. Revenues rose to $1.19 billion from $1.17 billion.

"Sales growth during the quarter remained strongest in the United States and was led by professional Power Tools and Accessories, Kwikset Security Hardware and Price Pfister Plumbing Products," said Nolan Archibald, chairman and chief executive officer.
He said that sales of household products sales were not as strong as last year, and the European market remained weak during the quarter.
Black & Decker's stock was up 12.5 cents at $41.125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
